name: delta
notes: parse_delta_filter_logline is a default macro that casts its argument to a fixed STRUCT (src/delta_macros.cpp); it reads nothing itself, the delta_filter_pushdown_log macros that join duckdb_logs are elevated.

get_delta_test_expression takes no arguments and returns the kernel's built-in testing expressions (src/functions/expression_functions.cpp, ffi::get_testing_kernel_expression). It is a test registration rather than a supported caller surface, so it is elevated per the classification criteria even though it discloses nothing about the host.
